verses.zh: 不要为明日自夸，因为一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。
verses.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.en: Do not boast about tomorrow, because you do not know what a single day will bring.

verses.zh: 要别人夸奖你，不可用口自夸；等外人称赞你，不可用嘴自称。
verses.kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.en: Let someone else praise you, not your own mouth; a stranger, not your own lips.

verses.zh: 石头重，沙土沉，愚妄人的恼怒比这两样更重。
verses.kjv: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
verses.en: A stone is heavy and sand is a weight, but a fool's anger is heavier than both.

verses.zh: 忿怒为残忍，怒气为狂澜，惟有嫉妒，谁能敌得住呢？
verses.kjv: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
verses.en: Anger is cruel and rage is a flood, but who can stand up against jealousy?

verses.zh: 当面的责备强如背地的爱情。
verses.kjv: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
verses.en: Being corrected openly is better than being loved in secret.

verses.zh: 朋友加的伤痕出于忠诚；仇敌连连亲嘴却是多余。
verses.kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.en: A friend who hurts you means well; an enemy's many kisses do not.

verses.zh: 人吃饱了，厌恶蜂房的蜜；人饥饿了，一切苦物都觉甘甜。
verses.kjv: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.en: A full person turns down honey, but to a hungry person even bitter food tastes sweet.

verses.zh: 人离本处飘流，好像雀鸟离窝游飞。
verses.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.en: Someone far from home is like a bird that has wandered from its nest.

verses.zh: 膏油与香料使人心喜悦；朋友诚实的劝教也是如此甘美。
verses.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
verses.en: Sweet oil and perfume make the heart glad, and so does a friend's honest advice.

verses.zh: 你的朋友和父亲的朋友，你都不可离弃。你遭难的日子，不要上弟兄的家去；相近的邻舍强如远方的弟兄。
verses.kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.en: Do not leave your own friend or your father's friend. When trouble comes, do not go to a distant relative — a neighbour nearby is better than a brother far away.

verses.zh: 我儿，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心欢喜，使我可以回答那讥诮我的人。
verses.kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.en: My son, be wise and make my heart glad, so I can answer anyone who mocks me.

verses.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.en: A sensible person sees trouble coming and hides; a simple person walks on and suffers for it.

verses.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服；谁为外女作保，谁就承当。
verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.en: Take the coat of anyone who promises to pay a stranger's debt; hold it as a pledge.

verses.zh: 清晨起来，大声给朋友祝福的，就算是咒诅他。
verses.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.en: Shouting a loud blessing to your neighbour early in the morning will be taken as a curse.

verses.zh: 大雨之日连连滴漏，和争吵的妇人一样；
verses.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.en: A quarrelsome person is like a tap dripping all through a rainy day.

verses.zh: 想拦阻她的，便是拦阻风，也是右手抓油。
verses.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
verses.en: Trying to hold them back is like holding back the wind, or grabbing oil with your hand.

verses.zh: 铁磨铁，磨出刃来；朋友相感也是如此。
verses.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.en: Iron sharpens iron, and one person sharpens another.

verses.zh: 看守无花果树的，必吃树上的果子；敬奉主人的，必得尊荣。
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.en: Whoever looks after the fig tree gets to eat its fruit, and whoever looks after their master is honoured.

verses.zh: 水中照脸，彼此相符；人与人，心也相对。
verses.kjv: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.en: Water reflects a face, and a person's heart reflects the person.

verses.zh: 阴间和灭亡永不满足；人的眼目也是如此。
verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.en: Death and the grave are never full, and neither are human eyes.

verses.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。
verses.kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
verses.en: A pot tests silver and a furnace tests gold, and praise tests a person.

verses.zh: 你虽用杵将愚妄人与打碎的麦子一同捣在臼中，他的愚妄还是离不了他。
verses.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.en: You could crush a fool with grain in a bowl, and his foolishness still would not leave him.

verses.zh: 你要详细知道你羊群的景况，留心料理你的牛群；
verses.kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
verses.en: Know exactly how your flocks are doing, and take good care of your herds,

verses.zh: 因为资财不能永有，冠冕岂能存到万代？
verses.kjv: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
verses.en: because riches do not last for ever, and a crown does not pass down through every generation.

verses.zh: 干草割去，嫩草发现，山上的菜蔬也被收敛。
verses.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.en: The hay is cut, new grass appears, and the mountain plants are gathered in.

verses.zh: 羊羔之毛是为你作衣服；山羊是为作田地的价值，
verses.kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
verses.en: The lambs will give you clothing, and the goats will pay for a field.

verses.zh: 并有母山羊奶够你吃，也够你的家眷吃，且够养你的婢女。
verses.kjv: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.en: There will be plenty of goats' milk for your food, for your household, and for your servant girls.
